sloka: हीयमानम् अथ अपश्यत् सुग्रीवम् वानरेश्वरम् ।प्रेक्षमाणम् दिशः च एव राघवः स मुहुर् मुहुर् ॥४-१६-३१॥
transliteration: hīyamānam atha apaśyat sugrīvam vānareśvaram ।prekṣamāṇam diśaḥ ca eva rāghavaḥ sa muhur muhur ॥4-16-31॥

translations.english: Raghava perceived that the monkey king Sugriva whose strength was waning was looking again and again in all directions (seeking help).
